tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get the current order details including product, status, issue, and any pending or completed resolution. Returns complete order state as JSON.

order_id.description: The order ID to look up (e.g. "1042")

tools.name: prepare_replacement
tools.description: Prepare a replacement shipment for a damaged order. This stages the replacement for human approval — it does NOT execute it. The customer must explicitly approve via the website UI before the replacement is created. Only works when the order has a reported issue and no pending resolution.

order_id.description: The order ID to prepare replacement for

reason.description: Brief reason for the replacement request

tools.name: confirm_replacement
tools.description: Confirm and finalize a previously prepared replacement. IMPORTANT: This will only succeed AFTER the customer has approved the replacement via the website UI. If the customer has not yet clicked "Approve", this will return an error. Use get_order to check the current approval status.
